newsitem.title: USA: Albright to throw out baseball on Opening Day.
newsitem.headline: Albright to throw out baseball on Opening Day.

text.p: U.S. Secretary of State Madeleine Albright will participate in one of America's most beloved rituals -- throwing out the first ball on Opening Day of the baseball season, U.S. officials said on Thursday.
Albright will do the honours next Tuesday when the Baltimore Orioles meet the Kansas City Royals at Camden Yards in Baltimore.

Although accomplished in many areas, Albright, 59, the first female American secretary of state, has not been a baseball player and so will practice pitching over the weekend with members of her security detail, one aide said.

Jordan's King Hussein is due in Washington that same day for talks with U.S. President Bill Clinton about the embattled Mideast peace process and Albright is scheduled to host a luncheon for him before dashing to Baltimore for the game.
